newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela approves CANTV local investor plan.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela approves CANTV local investor plan.

text.p: Venezuela has approved plans to encourage small local investors to buy shares in the forthcoming 40 percent share offering of telephone company CANTV, ministers said.
"A mass of small Venezuelan investors will now be able to buy shares," Information Minister Fernando Egana told reporters after a meeting of the cabinet of ministers.

The plan, made possible in large part after Congress passed Wednesday a reform of Venezuela's Privatization Law, provides incentives for potential CANTV shareholders willing to invest between 100,000 and five million bolivars ($212 to $11,000), Egana said.
Egana gave no more details, but Venezuelan Investment Fund President Alberto Poletto is due to unveil details at a press conference scheduled for Thursday morning.
